gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noticia-text: Grandstander draws every letter like bent pipe, one constant width, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Noticia Text follows with a classic serif's generous entry strokes and lowercase that fills most of the line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-piazzolla: Bold and playful is how Grandstander comes across, its lines laid down like fine rope in open letter shapes. And Piazzolla settles beneath as a classic serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with a widely opened e.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-pridi: Chunky, friendly, all pipe-like strokes with horizontals as heavy as verticals, Grandstander is hard to miss up top. Pridi's serif letters stand proud and spacious, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, its counters spilling open into the space around them. Grandstander's rope-like heading letters sit above that, so a long passage feels sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-slabo-13px: Grandstander is true monoline, every stroke one unbroken width with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Slabo 13px, a classic serif with big open counters in a, e and s, keeps long reading feeling bookish and dignified.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-suwannaphum: Grandstander's unmodulated line runs across every glyph, bold and expressive, with letters held open rather than curled shut. Suwannaphum, a classic serif, does the editorial work, its high x-height and open c carrying the text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-epunda-slab: Gugi is the loud one here, distinctive and bold. Its stylus-width strokes make the heading stand out, while Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, handles the steady text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-fauna-one: Dignified sits at the heart of Fauna One. Its tall middle band, shallow ascenders and generous e make it the body to enlarge a touch, while Gugi's tall lowercase and uniform curves keep the heading unmistakable.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-glegoo: Tall lowercase, no hairlines, open terminals: Gugi looks like lettering cut from tubing. Glegoo, a refined serif with big counters and wide unclosed mouths, does the quieter job of carrying editorial text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hanuman: Rope-bent lines and tall lowercase give Gugi a sculpted look. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, then carries a long passage with traditional, refined ease.
